caption: The drawing depicts a formal dress displayed on a featureless mannequin bust, shown from the front. The dress is predominantly light blue with a silky, wavy texture and a voluminous, dome-shaped skirt that extends widely from a fitted waist. The dress features an off-the-shoulder bodice with two blue, draped bands, edged in white lace, forming a V shape at the chest. In the center at the front of the bodice, there is a decorative arrangement of flowers in shades of purple, pink, yellow, and green leaves. Additional floral appliqués, mainly in pink with green leaves, are arranged near the bottom right and left sides of the skirt. In the background to the right, a simplified, unfinished pencil sketch of the same dress is shown, including only the outline and the general decoration placements. The background of the image is plain, light beige.
title: Dress
